source_note: Repository directories named supabase are historical source paths. No Supabase runtime was used.
assessment_rule: All sixteen H2 lifecycle gates were assessed against exact current source. PASS means executed H1 evidence only. H2-owned consumer work is never converted to PASS by H1 producer evidence.

gates.name: Certified admission and one-click readiness
gates.evidence: Exact SEALED_CURRENT/current-session reference admission and idempotent operation creation passed rollback-contained PostgreSQL 17 and 18 first use. Missing, stale, mismatched and tampered references fail before Draft financial state.

gates.name: Worker route activation
gates.evidence: Independent source check confirms broker/src/banking-pay-draft-certified-v8.js is not imported or invoked by the current dispatcher.

gates.name: Compact certified input projection
gates.evidence: H1 admission independently validates the nine-key reference/current session/channel/same-week proof and persists only pay_channel_scope, equal draft_scope and same_week_paye_override. Exact direct-RPC replay passes; missing or altered compact facts fail closed. No selected arrays or economic facts are copied. The actual H2 Worker operation-start call remains open because H2-L02 is not activated.

gates.name: Bounded certificate staging and final freeze
gates.evidence: H1 start, append, seal and paged readers reconcile exact counts and V1-compatible constituent/partition/overall digests. The actual Worker-to-PostgREST producer sealed 5,000 rows via 79 append calls and 131 durable deliveries in 160,591 ms without timeout or lost continuation.

gates.name: Timesheet financial readiness
gates.evidence: H1 normalized entries retain typed timesheet_id per constituent. H2 currently freezes an empty selected_timesheet_ids_json and its V8 route does not page distinct frozen Timesheet IDs into the unchanged DRAIN_TSFIN owner; restoring the phase alone would process zero Timesheets.

gates.name: Payee readiness
gates.evidence: H1 supplies the certified source facts; the V8 Draft phase sequence does not call ENSURE_PAYEE_READINESS/revolutEnsurePayeesReadyFromPreview.

gates.name: Row-backed Candidate and channel scopes
gates.evidence: H1 exposes normalized ordered constituents, normalized partition membership, ALL/PAYE/UMBRELLA counts/digests/totals and bounded terminal-sentinel pages. H2 owns the final row-backed frozen scope.

gates.name: Allocation, items and finance handoff
gates.evidence: H1 records expected allocation/item/reservation source facts without producing Draft outputs or changing economics. H2 must pass every certified row to the unchanged allocation, item and finance owners.

gates.name: Reservations, summaries, snapshots and breakdowns
gates.evidence: H2 must drain every existing downstream owner to has_more=false with replay/response-loss proof. H1 creates none of these Draft artifacts.

gates.name: Integrity and constituent parity
gates.evidence: Independent source inspection confirms the current H2 parity routine serializes but does not enforce expected allocation basis/result/source digest, item semantic/source-identity/source digest and reservation applicability/source digest. It can also require a reservation before consulting NOT_APPLICABLE. Exact Draft semantics must come from unchanged owners, not an invented generic finance-case rule.

gates.name: Empty-shell and failure cleanup
gates.evidence: The V8 database step returns EMPTY_RESERVED_BATCH_CLEANUP_REQUIRED and TERMINAL_FAILURE_REQUIRED; no V8 Worker branch consumes them through the accepted abort/refresh owners.

gates.name: Terminal success publication
gates.evidence: The terminal database owner validates core IDs/counts, but the V8 Worker does not consume READY_FOR_TERMINAL_FINISH, construct the complete accepted V1 success result, call finish exactly once, or schedule the post-Draft Workbench wake.

gates.name: Durable continuation and bounded RPCs
gates.evidence: H1 producer messages are <=2,048 bytes, delayed one second, advance at most eight append/four seal steps per delivery, use the existing queue, and passed 5,000 rows with no browser dependency. H2 must connect its Draft operation dispatcher and prove retry/DLQ semantics.

gates.name: Frontend polling and result interpretation
gates.evidence: Workbench rows remain visible while certificate sealing continues; Create Draft stays disabled until SEALED_CURRENT; polling stops only at exact Draft safety. The existing Draft UI remains capped at 99 percent until H2 calls the accepted terminal owner.

gates.name: Execute Payment and downstream contract equivalence
gates.evidence: H1 provides the comparison oracle only. H2 must prove identical durable Draft and downstream artifacts for all 15 families/88 classes; no real payment/provider action is authorised.

gates.name: Release, security, rollback and Miget TEST acceptance
gates.evidence: Merged source is based on exact origin/test 16b299bf. db:check is 212/518; V8 catalogue is 39/39; merged PostgreSQL 17 contract hash is fcf3895ad455d3e5fff66476c45542171261a9edf053670dfe22a617525aea70; PostgreSQL 17 rollback first use passed; PostgreSQL 18 H1 definitions match and earlier H1 NEW/UPGRADE passed. Exact final H1/H2 combined PG17/18 replay, installation and browser acceptance remain mandatory.

known_h2_corrections_before_combined_pas: Activate the certified V8 helper in the current Worker route.
Page distinct Timesheet IDs from frozen typed rows and run unchanged TSFIN readiness.
Consume cleanup, failure and terminal work kinds exactly once.
Enforce every certified expected fact in constituent parity, including deliberate NOT_APPLICABLE reservations.
Complete the downstream Draft parity and durable continuation evidence.
